definitions.explanation: Sleeves that end between the elbow and the wrist, about seven tenths of the full length. Also a garment with such sleeves. Popular in spring and autumn.

examples.japanese: {七分袖|しちぶそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七分袖|しちぶそで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: Three-quarter sleeves are just right in spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{肌寒|はだざむ}い→肌寒い：13957_hadazamui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{七分袖|しちぶそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーディガン→カーディガン：04520_kaadigan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Mornings and evenings are a bit chilly, so it's handy to bring a cardigan with three-quarter sleeves.

notes:
{七分|しちぶ} (seven tenths) + ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧ (sleeve). The same {〜分|ぶ} counting gives {五分袖|ごぶそで} (elbow-length sleeves) and {七分丈|しちぶたけ} (cropped length, as of trousers).

- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧: short sleeves
